learning_objective: 🎯 We will use all our math skills to buy tickets, read maps, and have a great time at the virtual fair!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we visit a fair, we use our addition and subtraction skills to buy tickets for exciting rides and get the correct change back!
A map shows us where the food stalls and rides are. We can follow the directions like left, right, and straight to reach our favorite spots.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Living Room Fair
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a simple map of your living room. Mark the sofa as a roller coaster and the table as a food stall. Guide your family using the map!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use math in real life to pay for things and check our change.
⭐ Maps use simple lines and shapes to help us find our way around big places.
